description: Upstream grammar-backed binding edits with runtime-independent locations: one-based line and Unicode code-point column and length, CRLF counted once. Offsets are UTF-16 in JavaScript and UTF-8 in Rust; both must agree after conversion.

cases.name: JavaScript strings, comments, template and regex stay literal
JavaScript shadowing keeps the inner binding
JavaScript inner binding is renamed alone
JavaScript capture by an inner declaration is refused
cases.source:
const x = 1;
function f(y) { return x + y; }

cases.name: JavaScript astral identifier and CRLF locations
Rust strings, comments and shadowing
Rust capture is refused
Rust Unicode identifier
Lean comments, strings and astral identifiers
cases.source:
def 𝒙 : Nat := 1
-- 𝒙
def y : Nat := 𝒙 + "𝒙".length
cases.expected:
def base : Nat := 1
-- 𝒙
def y : Nat := base + "𝒙".length

cases.name: Lean binder shadowing
cases.source:
def x : Nat := 1
def f (x : Nat) : Nat := x + 1
def g : Nat := f x
cases.expected:
def one : Nat := 1
def f (x : Nat) : Nat := x + 1
def g : Nat := f one

cases.name: Lean capture is refused
cases.source:
def x : Nat := 1
def y : Nat := 2
def z : Nat := x + y

cases.name: Rocq comments, strings and shadowing
cases.source:
Definition x := 1.
(* x *)
Definition s := "x".
Definition f (x : nat) := x.
Definition g := f x.
cases.expected:
Definition one := 1.
(* x *)
Definition s := "x".
Definition f (x : nat) := x.
Definition g := f one.

cases.name: Rocq Unicode identifier
cases.source:
Definition α := 1.
Definition β := α + α.
cases.expected:
Definition gamma := 1.
Definition β := gamma + gamma.

cases.name: Rocq capture is refused
cases.source:
Definition x := 1.
Definition y := 2.
Definition z := x + y.
